svg.title: A prediction error becomes a treatment-routing error
svg.desc: Real TCGA-A2-A04W breast (TCGA-BRCA) histology illustrates whole-slide sampling only; marker status is not inferred for this specimen. An illustrative breast routing example compares molecular and image-predicted markers under the same pre-specified rule, yielding anti-HER2 versus endocrine assignments. The primary metric is distance-free misassignment, with treatment-distance-weighted errors secondary. No observed rates or counts are depicted.
svg.text: A prediction error becomes a treatment-routing error
Illustrative schematic · no study rates shown
